description: Validate a flight number and get flight details including airline name, arrival airport, terminal, and arrival time. If the result has verified: false, the flight was NOT found in the airline schedule for that date — tell the customer so, ask them to check the flight number and date, and do not call it verified. Use this to verify a customer's flight number before booking and auto-detect the correct terminal. Works with future scheduled flights.
name: validate_flight
title: Validate Flight Number
